audit.why: Sides on this page (Skill / Skill / Gwen / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen) already match the already-audited mirror on every row it changed (0, 2, 4, 5). 49.73% over 565 games supports an even-to-Gwen read.
audit.corrected: No chart edit. Ratings left untouched because the mirror's rating direction is internally inconsistent — see notes.

audit.why: Her real spike is the first-item AP timing, which the page already identifies; Volibear's are levels 1-2 before her dash and mist, and the two-item tank timing.
audit.corrected: Kept; Hallowed Mist's 22s and Frenzied Maul's 5s now anchor the advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields treat Hallowed Mist as a safe zone you must wait out, and two tell you to dive her 'out of' the mist.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The counterplay is stepping into the cloud, not standing outside it waiting 22 seconds. You cannot pull her out — Volibear has no displacement.
audit.corrected: Step inside Hallowed Mist to target her; land Stormbringer in the cloud, not beside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] credits Volibear's ult with 'untargetable-cleanse pressure'.
audit.why: Stormbringer leaps, slows, damages, grants bonus health and disables towers. There is no cleanse and no untargetability in Riot's text — this is an invented mechanic.
audit.corrected: Removed; the leap is described by what it actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Stack pure HP' but its text is generic filler about burning a cooldown, and report[8] says the anti-heal cuts 'his' healing.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage based on the target's health and heals her off it, so raw HP literally feeds her damage and her sustain. That is the reason the title exists and it was never written down.
audit.corrected: Raw HP feeds her passive — buy MR, and buy anti-heal for her passive's healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] writes 'Snip Snip' without the exclamation mark, and the page never mentions the true damage on it.
audit.why: The ability is Snip Snip!, and Riot's text says 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center' — so MR does not answer the middle of her cone.
audit.corrected: Snip Snip!; its centre is true damage.

edits.before: You dominate early: Thundering Smash (Q) runs Gwen down before her Skip 'n Slash (E) is reliable, Frenzied Maul (W) out-heals her Snip Snip (Q) poke, and Sky Splitter (E) punishes her when she's low on Mist.
edits.after: You dominate early: Thundering Smash (Q) runs Gwen down before her Skip 'n Slash (E) is reliable, Frenzied Maul (W) heals every 5s through her Snip Snip! (Q) poke, and Sky Splitter (E) punishes her while Mist is on 22s.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) leap plus Q stun catches Gwen before she can Skip 'n Slash (E) dash away, and your ult's untargetable-cleanse pressure lets you dive into her Hallowed Mist (W) cloud.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) leap plus Q stun catches Gwen before she can Skip 'n Slash (E) away — and you can only hit her inside Hallowed Mist (W), so land the leap in the cloud, not beside it.

edits.before: R leap plus stun lets you dive her out of the Hallowed Mist at Level 6.
edits.after: At 6 your R leap and stun let you fight her inside Hallowed Mist itself.

edits.before: Dive her while she's outside Hallowed Mist (W)
edits.after: Step inside Hallowed Mist (W) to target her

edits.before: Retreat into Hallowed Mist (W) so your ranged pressure and autos miss
edits.after: Retreat into Hallowed Mist (W) so you cannot target her from outside

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. All-in when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s; she is untargetable from outside it, so step in rather than wait it out.

edits.before: She’s safe inside it. All-in when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s, and she is only targetable by enemies standing inside it. Step in.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside it. All-in when down. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in her.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s and only enemies inside it can target her. Snip Snip!'s centre deals true damage.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her passive scales with your max health, so raw HP feeds it — buy MR instead.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Sundered Sky  (the all-in sustain spike), then Spirit Visage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts his healing.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Sundered Sky  (the all-in sustain spike), then Spirit Visage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts her passive heal.

notes: Ratings deliberately untouched. The mirror set gwen's phases[2]/[4] to side Gwen at 4/10 and phases[5] to side Gwen at 3/10 — on her own page, i.e. low ratings on rows she wins — which is the opposite convention to this page, where a Gwen row carries a low rating because the rating reads from Volibear's side. I did not propagate a convention I could not confirm. The sides themselves already agree across both pages, so the chart renders consistently either way.
